items.claim: Spasic is facing a stern test in her UFC debut.
items.quote: Giving her a stern test right away.

items.claim: Jovon Lea won a decision against a tough, strong wrestler in Azamat Niflev on the Contender Series.
items.quote: he fought a pretty tough opponent, Azamat Niflev, who was 13-1 and a strong wrestler. It wasn't the most entertaining fight ever, but he did go out and win a decision.

items.claim: Alexander Popek is a light heavyweight fighting as a natural heavyweight.
items.quote: Pope, he's a light heavyweight typically.

items.claim: Alexander Popek allows opponents to dictate the pace and pressure.
items.quote: I don't like that he allows some of his opponents to dictate the pace and pressure.

items.claim: Alexander Popek runs the risk of getting caught backing up against a big heavyweight like Lea.
items.quote: I kind of see him getting backed up and you know, he's running the risk of getting caught on the feet backing up.

items.claim: Jovon Lea hits hard with good straight rights and a dangerous headkick.
items.quote: Lea hits hard. He's got good straight rights. He's got a dangerous headkick.
